purpose: Section 52 — **POSTES, TELECOMMUNICATIONS ET NOUVELLES TECHNOLOGIES DE L'INFORMATION ET DE LA COMMUNICATION (PTNTIC)**, exercice 2024. Domestic-state share of the section's appropriation.
scope_basis: Whole-section appropriation of a multi-purpose ministry — posts, telecommunications and (to FY2025) ICT. Recorded `partial` under the envelope rule; held for the trajectory and for the named digital projects inside it. Amount is the domestic share only.
doc_locator: Loi de finances n°23/056 du 10 décembre 2023 pour l'exercice 2024, Volume 2, Développement par titre des crédits, *Synthèse des dépenses par administration*, `SECTION 52`; origin split from *Détails des dépenses par section et rubrique budgétaire*
notes: ⚠ A MACHINERY-OF-GOVERNMENT CHANGE IN FY2026 MOVES THE ICT MANDATE AND ITS MONEY.** The section · names change in the enacted volumes: section 52 goes from *Postes, Télécommunications **et · Nouvelles Technologies de l'Information et de la Communication (PTNTIC)*** to plain ***Postes et · Télécommunications*** — the NTIC mandate is dropped — while section 71 goes from *Numérique* to · Économie numérique***. The money follows: section 52 falls **145,650,630,007 → 55,095,958,006 FC · (−62%)** and section 71 rises **60,627,481,411 → 226,713,223,741 FC (+274%)**. · Neither section's series can be read on its own across FY2025→FY2026**, and any statement about · "the digital ministry's budget" must say which section and which year. Combined, the two sections · are 219,729,663,315 (FY2024) → 206,278,111,418 (FY2025) → 281,809,181,747 (FY2026) FC, i.e. · 0.58% → 0.45% → 0.57% of the total budget** — so the headline jump in section 71 is substantially · a transfer, not new money. · The origin gate is printed in the volume.** The *développement par titre* separates · `Investissements sur Ressources Extérieures`** from **`Investissements sur Ressources Propres`**, · so the domestic share is the state's own disclosure and not an apportionment (driver → *Origin — · the double-counting gate*). The amount recorded here is the **section total less the external · investment group**. · ⚠ FY2024 execution cannot be attributed to this section.** DRC's FY2024 execution états are · published by *function* and by *economic rubrique*, never by administrative section. The digital · sub-function **`04600`** shows Crédits Votés **158,331,308,819 FC** — which is neither section 52 · (132,595,229,324) nor section 71 (87,134,433,991) nor their sum (219,729,663,315), so **the · functional and administrative classifications do not map onto each other** and no FY2024 outturn is · claimed for either section. The FY2025 *situation provisoire (format FMI)* does report by section; · its FY2024 equivalent is not published and is on the acquisitions list. · The external investment excluded here is very large relative to the section.** FY2024: FC · 95,512,273,724 of a 132,595,229,324 section, i.e. **72% of the ministry's budget is external · investment**. FY2025: FC 105,512,273,724 of 145,650,630,007, i.e. **72%** again. Only the remainder · is recorded. · The FY2024 external line names its financier and the FY2025 lines do not.** FY2024 reads · `193016 Banque mondiale / Projet CAB5 cinquième phase — 95,512,273,724 FC`. FY2025's external group · is three unattributed lines (*Acquisition d'equipements divers* 92,291,041,224, *Rehabilitation du · batiment du SG* 12,591,650,000, *Acquisition des vehicules…* 629,582,500). Per the origin gate, a · line naming no funder beyond "external" fails fact 1, so **no `non-state` record is built from the · FY2025 lines** — the magnitude is recorded here instead. · Domestic named projects cross-foot exactly** to FC 16,197,837,429: *Etude de l'implémentation de · Télécentres* 8,000,000,000 · *Acquisition des équipements GATEWAY de contrôle* (SCPT) 4,193,837,429 · · Rehabilitation du batiment du SG* 2,000,000,000 · **_Accès au câble sous-marin EQUIANO_ (SCPT) · 2,000,000,000** · *Optimisation du Data Center* (SCPT) 4,000,000. · `amount_usd` left blank.** No named fiscal-year-average CDF/USD rate is held, and the driver · forbids spot-converting a fiscal-year figure.

purpose: Section 71 — **NUMERIQUE**, exercice 2024. Domestic-state share of the section's appropriation.
